submitted.rationale: Index 5 (Sb 0.231) had the highest measured EQE, 0.0735%. The neighbours were lower: 0.0449% at Sb 0.142 and 0.0584% at Sb 0.271. Values fell sharply at higher Sb: 0.0156% at 0.488 and 0.0046% at 0.712. XRD at Sb 0.14, 0.23 and 0.31 shows the same single-phase pattern (possibly rutile-type, not checked against simulated patterns), so EQE seems to depend on composition within one phase, peaking near Sb 0.23.

rejected.reason: EQE 0.0584%, lower than index 5; the quadratic fit's predicted peak near Sb 0.29 was not confirmed
